BlackHolePower.summary: after a star-spending card play (last in series) or any star gain: Amount unpowered damage to all hittable enemies

BlockNextTurnPower.summary: AfterBlockCleared on owner: gain Amount unpowered block, then remove

BorrowedTimePower.summary: owner's cards cost +Amount energy (TryModifyEnergyCostInCombat); removed at owner's side turn end

CacophonyPower.summary: Instanced; counter var Cards 33 decremented per card drawn; at 0: Amount unpowered damage to a random hittable enemy (CombatTargets), reset to 33

CalcifyPower.summary: ModifyDamageAdditive +Amount on powered attacks dealt by the owner's Osty

CallOfTheVoidPower.summary: BeforeHandDraw: Amount cards from the character pool (unlocked, not Basic/Ancient), each First(GetDistinctForCombat(...,1, CombatCardGeneration)) made Ethereal, into hand

ChildOfTheStarsPower.summary: AfterStarsSpent by owner: gain Amount x stars spent unpowered block

ConquerorPower.summary: SovereignBlade powered attacks against the owner deal x2; decrements at owner's side turn end

CountdownPower.summary: AfterSideTurnStart (owner participates): Amount Doom to a random hittable enemy (CombatTargets)

CrushUnderPower.summary: TemporaryStrengthPower (negative): Strength -Amount until the target's side turn ends

DanseMacabrePower.summary: BeforeCardPlayed: owner plays a card with resolved energy cost >= 2 -> Amount unpowered block

DebilitatePower.summary: consulted by VulnerablePower/WeakPower: doubles their effect on the owner (sim has IVulnerableMultiplierModifier/IWeakMultiplierModifier); decrements at owner's side turn end

DevourLifePower.summary: AfterCardPlayed: owner plays a Soul -> Summon Amount

DieForYouPower.summary: on Osty: powered attacks aimed at the pet owner hit Osty while alive (ModifyUnblockedDamageTarget); dead Osty stays in combat; power survives owner death

DoomPower.summary: enemy side: BeforeSideTurnEnd of the enemy turn; player side: AfterSideTurnEnd of the player turn; the first doomed participant (CurrentHp <= Doom) triggers DoomKill of every doomed creature on that side, then Hook.AfterDiedToDoom

DrawCardsNextTurnPower.summary: +Amount hand draw on the next turn (AmountOnTurnStart != 0), removed after that turn starts

EnergyNextTurnPower.summary: AfterEnergyReset: gain Amount energy, then remove

ForegoneConclusionPower.summary: BeforeHandDraw: ShuffleIfNecessary, choose Amount cards from the draw pile into hand, remove power

HammerTimePower.summary: AfterForge by owner: every other living player forges the same amount

HangPower.summary: damage from Hang cards to the owner x Amount

HauntPower.summary: AfterCardPlayed: owner plays a Soul -> Amount unblockable unpowered damage to a random hittable enemy (CombatTargets)

LethalityPower.summary: owner's first Attack started this turn (not a replay): x(1 + Amount/100) damage

MonarchsGazePower.summary: AfterDamageGiven by owner (powered attack): MonarchsGazeStrengthDownPower Amount on the target

MonologuePower.summary: Instanced; each card the owner plays this turn grants Strength (var Strength), all reverted at side turn end

NecroMasteryPower.summary: AfterCurrentHpChanged: owner's Osty loses HP -> that loss x Amount unblockable unpowered damage to all hittable enemies

NeurosurgePower.summary: AfterSideTurnStart: Amount Doom on the owner

OblivionPower.summary: InstancedPerApplier on an enemy: each card the applier plays applies Amount Doom to the owner; removed at player side turn end

OrbitPower.summary: Instanced; each 4 energy the owner spends (cumulative) -> gain Amount energy

PagestormPower.summary: AfterCardDrawn: owner draws an Ethereal card -> draw Amount

PaleBlueDotPower.summary: once per turn when the owner has finished >= 5 card plays this turn: DrawCardsNextTurnPower Amount

ParryPower.summary: read by SovereignBlade: block = Amount when a blade is played

PillarOfCreationPower.summary: AfterCardGeneratedForCombat by owner: Amount unpowered block

PlatingPower.summary: block Amount at turn end (player) / start (enemy), decrements

ReaperFormPower.summary: AfterDamageGiven by owner or owner's pet (powered, TotalDamage > 0): TotalDamage x Amount Doom on the target

ReflectPower.summary: AfterDamageReceived (powered, blocked > 0): blocked amount back to the dealer (unpowered); decrements at owner's turn start

RetainHandPower.summary: ShouldFlush false for owner (hand retained); decrements at side turn end

SeekingEdgePower.summary: read by SovereignBlade: blade targets all enemies

ShroudPower.summary: AfterPowerAmountChanged: owner applies Doom -> Amount unpowered block

SicEmPower.summary: AfterDamageGiven by the applier's Osty to the owner -> Summon Amount; removed at the owner's side turn end

SleightOfFleshPower.summary: owner applies a non-temporary debuff to an enemy -> Amount unpowered damage to it

SoulboundPower.summary: the applier generates a Soul -> owner (another player) gets Amount Souls in draw pile

SpectrumShiftPower.summary: BeforeHandDraw: Amount distinct colorless cards into hand (CombatCardGeneration)

SpiritOfAshPower.summary: BeforeCardPlayed: owner plays an Ethereal card -> Amount unpowered block

StarNextTurnPower.summary: AfterEnergyReset: gain Amount stars, then remove

SwordSagePower.summary: every owner SovereignBlade BaseReplayCount += Amount (also on entering combat); reverted on removal

TheSealedThronePower.summary: BeforeCardPlayed: owner plays a card -> gain Amount stars

TyrannyPower.summary: +Amount hand draw; AfterPlayerTurnStart: choose Amount hand cards to exhaust

UnderworldPower.summary: ally (not owner, not owner's pet) powered damage -> TotalDamage x Amount Doom on the target; removed at enemy side turn end

VeilpiercerPower.summary: owner's Ethereal cards in hand/play cost 0 (Late); decrements when one is played

VigorPower.summary: +Amount damage on the owner's next powered card attack command, consumed after it

VoidFormPower.summary: first Amount non-auto-play cards each turn cost 0 energy and 0 stars

Debris.summary: 1-cost Status, Exhaust, no effect, not upgradable

SovereignBlade.summary: 2-cost Attack, Retain: 10 damage x Repeat; forged damage accumulates

SweepingGaze.summary: 0-cost Attack (OstyAttack), Ethereal+Exhaust: Osty hits a random enemy 10 (+5) (CombatTargets)
